Fable 5 is the AI model everyone's racing to max out this holiday weekend, but most people are pointing it at the wrong work. Here's how to get results that actually stand out.

My Links 🔗
👉🏻 Newsletter: https://natesnewsletter.substack.com/
👉🏻 X: https://x.com/natebjones
👉🏻 TikTok:   / nate.b.jones  
👉🏻 Instagram:   / nate.b.jones  

What's really happening inside the way serious users are running Fable 5?

The common advice is to plan with Fable 5 and code with something else, but the real move is using it to design the goal harness that steers whatever coding model you hand the work to.

In this video, I share the inside scoop on getting the most out of Fable 5:

How to wire Fable 5 into tools like Blender for real output
Why short prompts beat long ones on hard problems
What business problems are worth handing to it directly
How to build a goal harness that steers your coding model

Fable 5 is worth paying for even after the free tokens are gone, but only if you aim it at problems that genuinely need that horsepower.

title: Ultimate Guide To Claude Skills
text:
Guide to Claude Skills: https://clickhubspot.com/1bo6

I walk through how I create Claude skills and use them to make Claude work better for me.

Claude skills help me save prompts, follow steps, and use the same instructions again in new chats. I show what Claude skills are, where to find them, how to turn them on, and how to build a skill from scratch with the Claude skill creator.

I also show simple Claude skills examples, like a writing style skill, a deep research auditor, a CSV dashboard builder, a content engine, and an on-brand presentation maker. These Claude skills can help with YouTube scripts, PDF reports, dashboards, blog posts, LinkedIn posts, slides, and more.

I also talk about skill safety. Some Claude skills from the internet can be risky, so I show why I like building my own skills and checking the skill instructions before using them.

This is a simple guide to Claude skills for beginners. It is made to help you understand Claude skills, create your own Claude skills, and use Claude in a more useful way.
